embeds.title: BLHA TRADE BLOCK
embeds.description: Players and picks you're willing to move.

fields.name: POST FORMAT
fields.value: Name the player or pick, say what you're hoping to get back, and note any deadline.

fields.name: ALLOWED IN TRADES
fields.value: Rostered players, eligible draft picks and current-season FAAB. Cash, loans, rentals, predetermined tradebacks and conditional picks are prohibited.

fields.name: OFFICIAL RECORD
fields.value: A trade is official only when it is processed in Fantrax. Posts here don't bind anyone.
